history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Indonesian woman is posing confidently next to a large, gray, cylindrical pillar in what appears to be a brightly lit indoor shopping mall. She is wearing a black hijab, a dark blue denim shirt with two chest pockets and white buttons, and white, wide-leg pants. A brown Louis Vuitton monogram shoulder bag with gold hardware is slung across her right shoulder. Her left hand is resting on her hip, and her right hand is casually held in front of her.

The background features a decorative white gazebo adorned with artificial flowers in shades of pink and white, and a white picket fence. The floor is a polished marble with a subtle, intricate pattern. In the distance, through a railing, a retail display with a large advertisement is visible. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a mall environment, creating soft shadows. The overall color palette is a mix of cool blues and grays from the woman's outfit and the pillar, contrasted with the white of her pants and the gazebo, and the warm brown of the handbag. The mood is casual, stylish, and modern.
